lines.zh: 我踩水而过，六条腿一起划。
lines.en: I walk through water, all six legs rowing.

lines.zh: 我头上有一只角，往前顶着。
lines.en: I carry a horn on my head, pointed forward.

lines.zh: 这一身骨架，是走路的架子。
lines.en: This frame of mine is built for walking.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩走上岸，水从身上淌。
lines.en: I climb from the shallows, water running off me.

lines.zh: 我走过泥地，留一串深印。
lines.en: I cross the mud and leave a line of deep prints.

lines.zh: 我一半在水里，一半在岸上。
lines.en: Half in the water, half on the bank.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过水面，划出一条线。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the surface and draws a line.

lines.zh: 我低头看水，角映在里面。
lines.en: I look down and my horn is mirrored in the water.

lines.zh: 河岸的石头，被我踩得响。
lines.en: The river stones clatter under me.
I head upstream, where the water's slower.

lines.zh: 六条腿让我的步子很稳。
lines.en: Six legs make my stride very steady.
I push out through the reeds.
I stand with my horn aimed at the water.
Water slides off my back.

lines.zh: 我用前肢刨了刨岸边的泥。
lines.en: I paw the mud at the bank with a forelimb.
Six legs hold me up with little effort.
I'm watching the little fish in the water.
Wind comes up from the river mouth.
I raise my head and stare until my neck aches.
My tail sweeps the water and shoos small fish.

lines.zh: 我听见泥里有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving in the mud.

lines.zh: 我把头低到水面，喝了一口。
lines.en: I lower my head to the surface and drink.
The water's too shallow, so I shift.
There's weed hung on my horn.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，我歇一会儿。
lines.en: It's quiet here. I'll rest a while.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子换了个方向。
lines.en: I swing my long neck to the other side.
You've stood on the bank a long while.
My horn is longer than your arm.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块石头是我的。
lines.en: That stone you're standing on is mine.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水从下巴滴下。
lines.en: I raise my head, water dripping from my jaw.
Are you coming over, or leaving?
I've been looking at you a long while.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在头两边，看得见两处。
lines.en: My eyes are on both sides; I see two places.

lines.zh: 你别站在我的角和岸之间。
lines.en: Don't stand between my horn and the bank.
The water's going out. You'll be left here.
I don't mind if you stay.
Your clothes are dry.

lines.zh: 我身上一直在滴水，你的没有。
lines.en: I keep dripping. You don't.
I bellow and the water shudders.

lines.zh: 我前腿一沉，把身子压住。
lines.en: My forelegs drop and I brace myself.
My horn is knocked aside and I swing it back.
Blood drips into the river and spreads.
All six legs are trembling.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子缩到角后面。
lines.en: I pull my long neck behind my horn.
That one landed on bone.

lines.zh: 我往水里退，水能挡一挡。
lines.en: I retreat into the water; it shields me.
The wound stings worse in the mud.
That smell — I've remembered it.
That grass in your hand is tender.
I lower my head and come over slowly.
I'll eat most things by the water.
Step back. My horn is long.
Just set it down. I'll get it.
That smells like roots from the riverbed.
I take a bite and taste it.

lines.zh: 这些不够，我还能再吃一筐。
lines.en: Not enough; I could eat another basket.

lines.zh: 草举高些，我脖子够得着。
lines.en: Hold the grass higher; my neck can reach.
When I'm done I'll still be standing here.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的侧腹，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my flank and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我的腿比你高，撞不到我。
lines.en: My legs are taller than you; you can't reach me.

lines.zh: 这一下，水花溅在你身上。
lines.en: That splashed water on you.

lines.zh: 我侧身让，角差点刮到你。
lines.en: I turn aside and my horn nearly clips you.
I've left a hollow in the ground.
You back off and I stop.

lines.zh: 六条腿的骨架，撞上去硬。
lines.en: A six-legged frame — hard to bump into.
We part and the water sounds twice.
I move a leg to let you by.
This is a riverbank. Not much room.
My kind are over in the bend.

lines.zh: 浅水里，我们两头并排站着。
lines.en: In the shallows the two of us stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我有六条腿，水里也不慢。
lines.en: Six legs, and not slow in water.

lines.zh: 我们的头低下来，碰到一起。
lines.en: Our heads come down and touch.
The eggs will sink into the riverbed's sand.

lines.zh: 我们不守，它们自己会长。
lines.en: We won't guard them. They'll grow on their own.
The water will carry them downstream.
This river will have a few more of us.
Then we go our separate ways.

lines.zh: 这是它们的方式，也是我的。
lines.en: That's their way, and mine.
I bite and tip my head back to swallow.
It's muddy. I'll eat it anyway.
I hold it with a forelimb, then bite.
This mouthful is a bit tough.
I drag it up onto the bank.
What falls into the water is mine.
I chew slowly and loudly.
That will hold me a while.

lines.zh: 我吐掉了咬不动的部分。
lines.en: I spat out the part I couldn't chew.
Afterward I lower my head for a drink.
Water sounds over there, and it's wrong.
I see the reeds moving.
Not wind. Legs.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，角对着那个方向。
lines.en: I raise my head, horn pointed that way.
From here, a few strides.
The water's shallow. It can't run.
I turn my body toward it.
All six legs are planted.

lines.zh: 六条腿走路，我还没习惯。
lines.en: Six legs, and I'm still not used to it.
Let's see if it dares.
It's walking toward me.

lines.zh: 角已经对着你了，别怪我。
lines.en: My horn is pointed at you; do not blame me.
I lower my horn.
My jaw parts the surface.
I follow it through the shallows.

lines.zh: 水花的声音盖住了我的脚步。
lines.en: The splashing covers my steps.
It's making for the bank.
I swing across to block it.
Its path has narrowed.
I drop my head, horn forward.
When it stops, even my horn holds still.
The water's receding; the mud hardens.
I step up. Solid footing.

lines.zh: 我六条腿踩在浅水，慢慢来。
lines.en: My six legs wade the shallows, slowly.
It's backed to the stones. No way left.
I close in slowly.

lines.zh: 鼻孔喷出的气，水都皱了。
lines.en: My breath ripples the water's surface.
It's raised its hands.
The river bend has cut off its path.
I lunge, horn first.
A foreleg stamps and mud flies.

lines.zh: 这一下，把它撞进了水里。
lines.en: That knocked it into the water.
My tail whips across its flank.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，往水面甩两下。
lines.en: I bite and swing it twice toward the surface.
It caught my horn.
I press it down into the shallows.
The water reddens and slowly clears.

lines.zh: 它退开了，我只在原地喷气。
lines.en: It backs off; I only snort where I stand.
I stand on the bank, breathing hard.
There's something on my horn.
I rub it off in the water.
This stretch is quiet now.
I lower my head for another drink.

lines.zh: 我从河里站起来，水到腰。
lines.en: I rise from the river, water to my waist.

lines.zh: 六条腿在泥里找着落点。
lines.en: Six legs search the mud for footing.
This water is fresh. I like it.
A strand of weed is caught on my horn.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，水花散开。
lines.en: I shake and the water scatters.
There's more grass on the bank than on the bed.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩里，一步一步上岸。
lines.en: I walk up out of the shallows, step by step.
Waterbirds in the distance take flight.
I hear stones rolling upstream.
I stop first and look.

lines.zh: 这条河，我认得这种味道。
lines.en: I know this river's smell.
Long ago this was wider.
I test the bottom with a foot.
I can't shake the weed off my horn.
Ripples are forming over in the bend.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，水没到膝。
lines.en: I wade over, water to my knees.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我冲进河里。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I plunge into the river.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下，砸进浅水。
lines.en: I fall from the bank and crash into the shallows.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的鼻孔，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Water covers my nostrils and I strain to lift my head.

lines.zh: 炸响把河水掀起来，我站不住。
lines.en: The blast lifts the river and I can't keep my feet.
An arrow sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 一道冷光钻进骨头，我发僵。
lines.en: Cold light seeps into my bones and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 岸上的草都枯了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: The bank's grass has withered and I'm frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 六条腿站在浅水，稳得很。
lines.en: Six legs in the shallows hold steady.
No river below, and no mud.
